A.title: Demo A — HOT lead
A.summary: Hinglish parent, Class 9 CBSE, Andheri. Asks fees and instalments, picks the Thu 5 pm demo and shares a number.

turns.user: Namaste, Class 9 CBSE ke liye classes chahiye. Andheri mein branch hai?

bot.reply: Namaste! Haan, Andheri West mein branch hai, Lokhandwala ke paas. Student ka naam kya hai?

turns.user: Riya naam hai. Fees kitni hai?

bot.reply: Riya ke liye Class 9 (SSC / CBSE / ICSE) ki fees ₹52,000 per year hai. Kaunsa batch suit karega?
Ji haan, fees 3 instalments mein de sakte hain. Kaunsa batch theek rahega — Morning, Afternoon ya Evening?

turns.user: Evening batch theek rahega. Demo class kab hai?

bot.reply: Evening batch 6–8 pm hota hai. Free 60-minute demo class ke slots: Tue 5 pm, Thu 5 pm, Sat 5 pm ya Sun 11 am. Kaunsa slot chalega?

turns.user: Thu 5 pm perfect. Mera number 9800012345 hai.

bot.reply: Dhanyavaad! Thu 5 pm ka demo Andheri West mein note kar liya. Hamari counsellor aapko confirm karne ke liye call karengi.

B.title: Demo B — WARM lead
B.summary: Student asks JEE Foundation timings at Thane and the weekend batch, then hesitates on sharing a number. The bot asks once and doesn't push.

turns.user: Hi, JEE Foundation ke timings kya hain? Thane mein.

bot.reply: Hi! JEE Foundation Evening aur Weekend batch mein hota hai. Thane West mein Ghodbunder Road par branch hai. Aap kis class mein ho?
Haan, Weekend batch Sat–Sun 10 am–1 pm hota hai aur Thane West mein seats available hain. Fees ke baare mein bataun?
JEE Foundation (Class 9–10) ki fees ₹68,000 per year hai, 3 instalments mein. Student ka naam kya hai?

turns.user: Mera naam Kabir hai. Budget thoda tight hai, sochna padega.

bot.reply: Samajh sakti hoon, Kabir! 5% sibling discount hai, aur 30 April se pehle join karne par 10% early-bird discount. Free demo class mein aana chahoge? Parent ka number share karenge?

turns.user: Abhi nahi, pehle ghar par poochna hai. Is hafte centre aa sakta hoon.

bot.reply: Bilkul theek hai, koi pressure nahi! Jab suit kare centre aaiye aur faculty se milke decide kijiye.
